LightningComponentBundle.description: Submit a payment using an Account's saved card or ACH method.

property.name: paymentGatewayId
property.label: Payment Gateway Record ID
property.description: Preferred unique org-specific record ID of the active PaymentGateway.

property.name: paymentGatewayName
property.label: Payment Gateway Name
property.description: Legacy compatibility setting. Used only when Payment Gateway Record ID is blank; the name must identify one active gateway.

property.name: componentTitle
property.label: Component title
property.description: Title shown at the top of this component.

property.name: submitButtonLabel
property.label: Submit button label
property.description: Text shown on the sale button.

property.name: defaultPaymentType
property.label: Default payment type filter
property.description: Payment method type selected when the component opens.

property.name: showPaymentTypeSwitcher
property.label: Show Card / ACH switcher
property.description: Allow users to switch between saved card and ACH methods.

property.name: defaultAmount
property.label: Default amount
property.description: Initial amount shown in the sale form. The user can change it; the maximum remains 100,000.
